subject: Well i'm afraid that the
author: Kiwiharser
body:
Well i'm afraid that the average gamer signing up to such an online tracking site is considered more "hardcore" or serious than most. I think that amongst these more serious gamers there will be more that play revenge than amongst all users.
 

Considering all the people on live only for the yearly COD/FIFA, i think that paradise will be more popular. The ultimate pack thing seems to be in almost every single store for 10-15, perfect for a christmas present for your little kid.

subject: All that free extra money they got off Burnout 3
author: umopapisdnpuaq
body:
being a downloadable helped prolong it's server life I think.

I really have no idea on actual cost, but surely with the economies of scale that EA have it's relatively cheap to run them.

The decision may be based on stats but the human that determined what range of stats to take into account was a management moron making a financial decision. Not someone who's ever played a game they truly enjoy.

The worst thing is EA are scrubbing them out of existence forever since you can't ever direct things to your own servers or use LAN.
